sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: > Master Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) v2.7.0 (August 2026 release) — from hello-world to production deployment in 15 days.

sections.title: What's Inside
sections.body:
This course contains **15 Jupyter notebooks** (`.ipynb`) covering every major Google ADK Python concept, with:

- **865 total cells** of curated, production-ready content
- **60 progressive code examples** (4 per day, increasing in complexity)
- **50+ exercises** with full solutions
- **15 custom matplotlib diagrams** + ASCII art + Mermaid diagrams
- **Multi-LLM examples** (Gemini native + OpenAI/Claude via LiteLLM)

sections.title: Quick Start
sections.body:
### 1. Install ADK

```bash
pip install google-adk==2.7.0
pip install "litellm>=1.84"       # Optional: multi-LLM support
pip install jupyterlab            # To open .ipynb files
```

### 2. Get an API key

Get a **free Gemini API key** at [https://aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)

### 3. Open the index notebook

```bash
cd adk_15day_course
jupyter lab 00_START_HERE_index.ipynb
```

The index notebook links to all 15 day notebooks and provides the full roadmap.

sections.title: Course Phases
sections.body:
### Phase 1: Foundations (Days 1-3)
Install ADK, understand the architecture stack, learn the three core primitives (Agent, Runner, Session), and build your first multi-turn agent.

### Phase 2: Tools (Days 4-6)
Master the tool ecosystem: FunctionTool (auto-wrapped Python functions), ToolContext (state + artifacts + human-in-the-loop), AgentTool (agent-as-tool), and McpToolset (Model Context Protocol).

### Phase 3: Memory & State (Days 7-9)
Persistence layer: session state with `app:`/`user:`/`temp:` prefixes, three session services (InMemory, Database, VertexAi), and long-term memory + artifacts for cross-session recall and file storage.

### Phase 4: Multi-Agent Systems (Days 10-12)
Compose agents: sub-agents with transfer, workflow agents (Sequential/Parallel/Loop), and ADK 2.0's graph-based Workflow with typed data flow and human-in-the-loop pauses.

### Phase 5: Advanced Patterns (Days 13-15)
Production-grade features: all 8 callback types, ADK Web UI + A2A protocol + MCP server mode, and finally deployment to Cloud Run / Agent Engine / custom FastAPI with a capstone travel-planner project.

sections.title: ADK Version
sections.body:
This course targets **ADK Python v2.7.0** (released August 13, 2026) — the latest stable release. All code patterns and APIs are verified against the official documentation at [adk.dev](https://adk.dev).

### Key v2.7.0 features covered

- Models declare their own capabilities (output_schema + tools auto-detection)
- Tools can return media (images, audio) in function responses
- Jinja2 instruction templates with `use_jinja2=True`
- `McpToolset` elicitation_callback support
- `ReflectAndRetryModelPlugin` for self-healing model errors
- `BigQueryAgentAnalyticsPlugin` (new `bigquery-analytics` extra)
- Faster startup and hot paths
